parameters.subject: JUST A LIL REMINDER FOR YOUR WEEK

parameters.text:
=Write a warm, grounded, loving, and encouraging Monday morning email for my partner, {{ $('If').item.json.NAME }}.

Context:
- Today's Date: {{$now.format('MMMM Do YYYY') }}
- Current Week Number: Week {{ $now.format('ww') }} of 52

DYNAMIC WEEKLY THEMES (Rotate strictly based on Week {{$now.format('ww') }}):
- Weeks 1, 6, 11, 16, 21, 26, 31, 36, 41, 46, 51: Focus on emotional reassurance, partnership, and knowing I'm always in their corner.
- Weeks 2, 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, 32, 37, 42, 47, 52: Focus on belief in their talent, capability, and strength to tackle big goals at work/school.
- Weeks 3, 8, 13, 18, 23, 28, 33, 38, 43, 48: Focus on balance, pacing themselves, taking deep breaths, and avoiding over-stressing.
- Weeks 4, 9, 14, 19, 24, 29, 34, 39, 44, 49: Focus on gratitude for having them, appreciating their effort, and celebrating progress.
- Weeks 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50: Focus on energy, optimism, good vibes, and looking forward to quality time together.

STRICT VOICE & FORMAT RULES:
- LENGTH: Write EXACTLY 5 to 6 full sentences. Make it feel complete, warm, and intentional.
- TONE: Write like a real person sending a loving, supportive email to their partner. Grounded, real, affectionate, and genuinely motivating.
- STRICTLY FORBIDDEN (NO POETRY): Absolutely NO romantic imagery, metaphors, literary prose, or descriptions of nature/mornings. Never mention curtains, sunlight, skies, breezes, golden rays, whispers, dawn, or flowers. Write about real life, emotional support, and practical encouragement.
- NO CLICHES: Do not use robotic phrases like "As a new week dawns", "I hope this email finds you well", or "Crush your goals".

EXAMPLE OF THE EXACT TONE & LENGTH DESIRED:
"Hey babe, happy new week! I was just sitting here thinking about you and wanted to make sure you start your Monday with a little extra love. I know you have a busy week ahead, but I want you to remember how capable and amazing you are. Don't let the workload stress you out too much—just take things one single task at a time. I'm right here in your corner cheering you on, no matter what comes up. Have a wonderful day today, and know that I love you so much!"

INSTRUCTIONS:
- Craft a fresh 5 to 6 sentence message following the assigned theme for Week {{ $now.format('ww') }}.
- Output ONLY the body message text. Do NOT include subject lines, quotation marks, or sign-offs.remove hyphens and make the messages sound real. remember this is a weekly message to encourage him and send a motivational message for his new week so dont base it on a day but the whole week

=Write a short, high-energy, and genuinely encouraging motivational Monday message for {{ $('If').item.json.NAME }}.

Context:
- Today's Date: {{$now.format('MMMM Do YYYY') }}
- Current Week Number: Week {{ $now.format('ww') }} of 52

DYNAMIC WEEKLY THEME SELECTION:
Rotate the core focus based on Week {{$now.format('ww') }}:
- Weeks 1, 6, 11, 16, 21, 26, 31, 36, 41, 46, 51: Focus on execution, momentum, and taking the first step on big tasks.
- Weeks 2, 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, 32, 37, 42, 47, 52: Focus on mental resilience, pushing through hurdles, and staying adaptable.
- Weeks 3, 8, 13, 18, 23, 28, 33, 38, 43, 48: Focus on consistency, discipline over mood, and building steady daily habits.
- Weeks 4, 9, 14, 19, 24, 29, 34, 39, 44, 49: Focus on strategic clarity, eliminating distractions, and prioritizing what truly matters.
- Weeks 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50: Focus on celebrating wins, recognizing growth, and keeping a positive mindset.

STRICT VOICE & FORMAT RULES:
- LENGTH: Write EXACTLY 5 to 6 full sentences. Make it punchy, practical, and meaningful.
- TONE: Professional, charismatic, inspiring, grounded, and action-oriented. Sound like an authentic mentor or high-performance coach.
- STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Absolutely NO poetry, romantic prose, nature metaphors, or flowery literary descriptions. Keep it strictly focused on practical growth, work ethic, and real-life achievements.
- BANNED CLICHES: Do not use tired hype phrases like "Rise and grind", "Crush your goals", "Unleash your inner beast", "As a new week dawns", or "I hope this finds you well".

EXAMPLE OF THE EXACT TONE & LENGTH DESIRED:
"Happy new week, {{ $('If').item.json.NAME }}! As we get things rolling today, I want to challenge you to focus on momentum right from the start. It is easy to get overwhelmed by a long to-do list, but progress comes down to execution on one task at a time. Put your energy toward the highest priority goal first and build that momentum early. Stay focused on your growth, keep your standards high, and make this week count. Wishing you a productive and successful week ahead!"

INSTRUCTIONS:
- Generate a fresh 5 to 6 sentence message strictly following the assigned theme for Week {{ $now.format('ww') }}.
- Output ONLY the body text. Do NOT include subject lines, quotation marks, or sign-offs.
